verse.verse_1: Read with the name of your Lord Who created,
verse.verse_3: Read, and your Lord only is the Most Beneficent,
verse.verse_4: The One Who taught to write with the pen.
verse.verse_5: The One Who taught man all what he did not know.
verse.verse_6: Yes indeed, man is surely rebellious.
verse.verse_8: Indeed towards your Lord only is the return.
verse.verse_9: What is your opinion – regarding him who forbids –
verse.verse_10: A bondman when he offers the prayer?
verse.verse_11: What is your opinion – if he were upon guidance,
verse.verse_12: He would enjoin piety, so how good it would be!
verse.verse_13: What is your opinion – if he denies and turns away, how wretched will be his state!
verse.verse_14: Did he not realise that Allah is watching?
verse.verse_15: Yes certainly, if he does not desist, We will seize him by the forelock.
verse.verse_16: A forelock that lies, is sinful.
verse.verse_17: So let him now call his gang!
verse.verse_18: We will now call the guards!
verse.verse_19: Yes indeed; do not listen to him – and prostrate, and become close to Us. (Command of Prostration # 14)
